::: {#def-intervention .theorem}
## Intervention equation

A deterministic function $h_{X_{ki}}$ that returns a value in the range of the random variable $X_{ki}$ from the covariates preceding it in a topological order of the NPSEM, the elements of its own covariate that precede it, and the graph generators that precede it:

$$
h_{X_{ki}}:\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{X}_1)\times\dots\times\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{X}_{k-1})\times\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{X}_{k,<i})\times\mathcal{R}(\boldsymbol{\psi}_1)\times\dots\times\mathcal{R}(\boldsymbol{\psi}_T)\to\mathcal{R}(X_{ki}).
$$

The arguments are measured variables; the error term $U_{X_{ki}}$ is not among them. With a fixed network there are no graph generators among the arguments.
:::
